page.notes: The Greek running head is transcribed as printed. "fidcli" in the first paragraph is copied as it appears on the scan and is doubtful. "ut eo" reads "ut co" on the scan, and "impctu" may be a misprint of "impetu". Both are copied as seen. The large dots and stains on the page are not printed text and are left out. No marginal notes are visible. The catchword "14. De" is treated as the opening of the next chapter.
